_about: Snippets (keyword, cue and spoken-digit finders with linked context) are shown in the dashboard for every call. model_input decides what the extraction model reads: "snippets" (default) = only the snippets, with hits, scores and bold words; "full_transcript" = the whole call (baseline to compare recall and latency). Editable without code; a change produces a new extraction on the next pipeline run (cached separately).
_cues_note: cues_general.json is frozen and scenario-free; cues_tuned.json was tuned on the test calls and overfits. Empty string = keywords and digits only.
_if_no_snippets_note: full_transcript (default, safe): a call where no finder fires is read in full, so it can never be dismissed unseen. skip_model: no model call, the call becomes no_alert.
